Vs.
Sena Kalyan Sangstha and others  -------- Opposite Parties.
full_judgment:
a) To pass a decree declaring that the notice dated 3.9.92 for the Board meeting held on 7.3.92 is wholly illegal, without lawful authority, void, of no legal effect and malafide. 

 b) To pass a decree declaring that the resolution pertaining to transfer of M/s NV Philips of Holland's shares numbering 50,400 to Ws. Transcom Limited passed on 7.9.92 in the meeting of the Board of Directors is illegal, void, inoperative without lawful authority and malafide and not binding on the plaintiffs. 

 c) To pass a decree permanently restraining the defendant from acting on the basis of the resolution transferring 50,400 shares and giving effect to the resolution pertaining to transfer of shares passed in the meeting of the Board of Directors on 7.9.92. 

 d) To pass a decree restraining the defendant No. I from mutating the shares of M/s. NV Philips defendant No 6 in favour of M/s. Transcom Limited the defendant No. 7 in the share Register of the Company. 

 e) To pass a decree restraining the defendant No. 7 from purchasing the shares of M/s. NV Philips defendant No. 6 and making payment thereof to M/s. NV Philips the defendant No. 6. f) All costs of the suit.
